title: TurtleQuant
description: TurtleQuant Polymarket digital-option bot: status, equity, open positions, trade performance and shadow-soak quality.

panels.title: Bot
panels.description: Bot log written in the last 180 s (the BotStale alert threshold).

panels.title: Exporter
panels.description: Prometheus can scrape the exporter and the exporter can read the state files.

panels.title: Entry Gate

targets.expr: max by (reason) (turtlequant_entries_halted{strategy="$strategy"} == 1) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "reason", "entries allowed", "", "")

panels.description: HALTED shows the gate reason: broker_failures, data_errors, stale_data, drawdown, daily_loss or halt_file.

panels.title: Broker Failures
panels.description: Consecutive broker failures. The gate halts entries at 3.

panels.title: Positions File Age
panels.description: Seconds since the bot last rewrote its positions file.

panels.title: Marked Equity
panels.description: Realized NAV plus open positions marked at the executable bid. The drawdown gate uses this.

panels.title: Realized NAV
panels.description: Starting capital plus closed-trade P&L.

panels.title: Open Unrealized P&L
panels.description: Open positions marked to the last executable bid, net of the taker fee a sale would pay.

panels.title: Return on Capital
panels.description: Realized P&L over starting capital (NAV minus realized P&L).

panels.title: Exposure % NAV
panels.description: Total open size over NAV. The total exposure cap defaults to 40%.

panels.title: Marked Drawdown
panels.description: Marked equity below its high-water mark. Entries halt at 15%.

panels.title: Equity vs High-Water
panels.description: Marked equity (NAV plus open positions at the bid) against realized NAV and the risk high-water mark the drawdown gate measures from.

panels.title: Drawdown
panels.description: Underwater curve. The red band below -15% is where the drawdown gate halts entries.

panels.title: Open Positions
panels.description: One row per open position. Prices are in the held token's terms. Click a market to focus the lifecycle charts below on it.

value.title: Focus lifecycle charts on this market

panels.title: Net Delta by Asset
panels.description: Net dollar delta of open positions per underlying. Negative means the book profits when the asset falls.

panels.title: Market $position
panels.description: Held-token bid against what we paid and what the model said it was worth at entry. Mark converging toward the model line is the trade working.

panels.title: Closed Trade P&L (oldest → newest)
panels.description: Each bar is one of the last 50 closed trades, fee-adjusted. Rightmost is the latest (0 trades ago).

panels.title: Executable Quotes / 24h
panels.description: Candidates whose edge survived crossing the ask.

panels.title: Ask Erased Edge (recent)
panels.description: Share of recent shadow quotes where paying the ask wiped out the mid edge. Alert above 25%.

panels.title: Parser Hit Rate (recent)
panels.description: Alert below 75%.

panels.title: Synthetic Books
panels.description: Alert above 20%.

panels.title: Realized-Vol Fallback
panels.description: Alert above 30%.

panels.title: Book & Vol Source Mix
panels.description: Share of order books from the real CLOB and of vols from Deribit IV over the last 15 minutes. Anything else is a fallback.

panels.title: Avg Entry Slippage
panels.description: Average open-entry fill versus signal mid, in price units.
